levi_intro.7: Welcome to the realm of ideas.
levi_intro.10: You can still recover your memory.
levi_intro.11: You can still recover your soul.
levi_intro.12: You can still hear her one last time.
levi_intro.13: You can still rest in peace.
levi_intro.14: But none of those things are here.
levi_intro.16: There you'll be able to recover your memory.
levi_intro.17: You will have to get used to your ''new'' form.
levi_intro.18: You can come back here whenever you want...
orbe_30.2: But he wants to tell you something.
orbe_fin.2: You've done well, I've been watching.
orbe_fin.3: Don't think that it was because of me, I just helped you understand it.
orbe_fin.4: There are still some things that I didn't show you.
levi_fin.1: So that's the name you choose...
levi_fin.3: You don't really choose your name, your soul does.
levi_fin.5: And also the capacity of understanding what surrounds you.
levi_fin.6: At first you perceived it as a completely dark space. But now is an abstract infinite complexity.
levi_fin.7: Nobody understands it the same way, each one is different.
levi_fin.8: There's just one more thing for you.
levi_fin.9: I promised that you could hear her one last time.
levi_fin.10: You don't realise it, but there's no such thing as time here.
levi_fin.11: For you, taking form was a test that some beings may perceive as hours, perhaps days...
levi_fin.12: But your mother has been lamenting your death for years.
levi_fin.13: She thinks about you every single day. She knows it's a wound that will never heal.
levi_fin.14: She can't do anything but accept that that's her reality, even though it's the most painful one for her.
levi_fin.15: I will let you hear her one last time.
alicia.1: I don't know if you will somehow hear this message, Catalina.
alicia.2: If you even remember that name.
alicia.3: I just want to let you know that I'm sorry.
alicia.4: I was the blindest between us.
alicia.5: I shouldn't have tried to ''fix'' you, no... You were already perfect.
alicia.6: And now, I've lost you... forever.
alicia.7: When the system failed and the worst happened...
alicia.8: I panicked and immediately ran towards you to get you out of there, but I couldn't.
alicia.9: For entering so fast and without the necessary equipment... I don't know what happened to me but now I have... hallucinations.
alicia.10: Everytime I look at a mirror, I always see them:
alicia.11: Millions of eyes watching me. Recalling the memory of that day.
alicia.12: Since then, I've been developing an irrational fear of mirrors.
alicia.14: That phobia isn't common, it had a weird name.

levi_fin.19: There's nothing left for me to do. You two will be together once again, someday.
levi_fin.20: You can now rest in peace.
levi_fin.22: Sometimes a story just wants to be told.
levi_fin.23: Do no try to search complexity in simplicity. Neither try to ''understand'' everything.
levi_fin.24: Maybe this story made you realise something, maybe you've felt identified with it, maybe you feel like you didn't get anything, or that you lost your time.
levi_fin.25: Though a story just tries to explain itself, the impact it has on you depends on yourself.
levi_fin.26: There's one dialogue that said ''nobody understands it the same way, each one is different''.
levi_fin.27: At the end of the day I'm nothing but a bunch of characters, maths and lights arranged in a way.
levi_fin.28: At the end of the day I'm nothing but an illusion.
levi_fin.29: But I can't write myself. I can't teach myself. I can't do anything on my own.
levi_fin.30: I'm a message in a language that you will never comprehend flawlessly.
levi_fin.31: But that's what makes it personal, that's what makes it different. That's what makes you...
mini.3: Remember that helmet that lets people see beyond reality?
mini.4: I thought that it may be able to take care of your blindness.
mini5.unlock: A new path has been opened at the realm of ideas...
